editorial.blurb: En Hakkore brings creative Japanese-Korean fusion to Wicker Park with impeccably fresh sushi burritos and poke bowls that keep diners coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order for pickup or dine in rather than delivery—these delicate items are best enjoyed fresh and warm, straight from the kitchen.
signatureDishes: Fire and Shoyu Ahi Tuna Tacos
